data.title: Order confirmation: Glasfaser 300 internet contract
data.summary: Beispiel Glasfaser GmbH confirms your order of 19 March 2025 for Glasfaser 300 (300/150 Mbit/s) at €39.95 per month. Connection is planned for 8 April 2025, with a 12-month minimum term.
data.explanation: This confirms your new fibre internet contract. The line will be activated on 8 April 2025, and a technician will contact you beforehand. The minimum term is 12 months from activation. After that the contract runs indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. The first chance to cancel is at the end of the 12 months, also with one month's notice. The app tracks the cancellation dates. Keep this letter, as the contract summary (§ 54 TKG) is part of your contract.
